title: Niger follow-up agricultural evidence
purpose: Extend the INS 2024 national crop series and prior SIMA evidence with current official SIMA monthly consumer-market prices, regional market-price data availability, weekly bulletin coverage and 2026 seasonal context. No calculator data activated.

observations.status: FAO cites official estimate, close to the previous five-year average; aggregate cereals, not crop-specific.
Maize, millet and rice planting completed in July; sorghum planting completed in early August.
Early-season dryness affected establishment in parts of Tillabéri, Tahoua and Zinder; some replanting required.
Insecurity continues to constrain field access particularly in Tillabéri and Diffa; localized production shortfalls possible.

quality_notes: The 5.3 million tonne value is aggregate cereal output for 2025 and must not be allocated to individual crops.
Regional climate and security conditions vary; national average assumptions may conceal localized production risk.

decision.reason: This follow-up improves dated consumer-market and regional market intelligence, but does not confirm producer/farmgate prices, sack weights and grades for all products. The existing INS crop series remains national rather than region-by-crop, and current seed, crop-protection, irrigation, labour, machinery and livestock enterprise costs are incomplete.

next_actions: Request or obtain SIMA's filtered export with explicit price level, market, date, grade, product form, unit and sack weights; identify actual producer-level observations separately from consumer/wholesale prices.
Extract the eight-region crop output, harvested area and yield matrices for the supported calculator commodities and reconcile with INS national totals.
Extract SIMA fertilizer price rows with exact product, bag size, region, market and date; obtain seed, crop-protection, irrigation/energy, labour and machinery costs.
Build regional enterprise budgets by production system, including cowpea, rice, maize, onion and livestock only where commodity definitions match calculator profiles.
Obtain livestock offtake, liveweight or auction prices, feed, veterinary, mortality and production-cost evidence.
Map verified evidence into the existing calculator schema and add Niger test cases only after data and regression tests pass.
safeguards: Do not alter the original 10 working country profiles or calculator formulas.
Do not use SIMA consumer prices as farmgate revenue values.
Do not convert sack prices without verified sack weights.
Do not use national millet or sorghum series as substitutes for maize or rice profiles.
Do not treat livestock inventory as annual output or saleable offtake.
Do not activate Niger or publish a calculator test URL until mapping, build and regression tests pass.
